description: Throughout her career as a pirate, Big Mom established herself as one of the Four Emperors, a title reserved for the most influential and powerful pirates in the world. This status reflects not only her combat abilities but also her vast territory, loyal followers, and political influence. Governments, rival pirates, and criminal organizations all recognize her authority.
